modalities.evidence: CT Ventilation as a functional imaging modality for lung cancer radiotherapy

output.population: 20 lung cancer patients who underwent exhale/inhale breath hold CT, free-breathing 4DCT and Galligas PET ventilation scans in a single session.
output.summary: Breath-hold CT, four-dimensional CT and Galligas PET ventilation scans acquired in one session on a combined PET/CT scanner, enabling comparison of CT-derived and PET ventilation imaging.
